decision.observation: Hornet stands at about (0.51, 0.68), partly hidden behind the dark foreground, beside a stone block at about (0.49, 0.6). The camera panned slightly left. She has 1 of 5 masks and no silk.
decision.hypothesis: The stone block is the front of the terrace. Left+Z should get her up onto it, and from there Up+Left+Z reaches the upper-west shelf.
decision.memory: Light-shaft chamber areas so far are dead ends. If no health restore turns up, consider fighting the pale creature with diagonal down-slashes (Down+X while airborne). Dying probably respawns her with full health, possibly at a cost in shards.
